bio.text: Dusty Johnson is South Dakota's lone member of the U.S. House of Representatives.
He grew up in central South Dakota, holds degrees from the University of South Dakota and the University of Kansas, and lives in Mitchell with his wife and three sons.

He was elected to the South Dakota Public Utilities Commission in 2004, served as chief of staff to Gov. Dennis Daugaard starting in 2010, and was a vice president at the engineering firm Vantage Point Solutions.
